subject: independent verification of the freshness boundary closure (r7t1 / 07117de), plus a repeatable 14-case selftest
whyThisRound: r7t1 closed the three boundaries but its fixtures were ad hoc: they ran once in a terminal and left nothing in the repository. A gate change that only exists as a pasted transcript cannot be re-checked later, so this round pins the cases as a script and re-derives r7t1's claims independently.

objectUnderTest.commit: 07117de feat(evidence): close the freshness gate's cycle, nested tsconfig and d.ts boundaries
objectUnderTest.identity: the script the cases exercise is byte-identical to the committed one

addedSelftest.method: each case builds a throwaway workspace under the OS temp dir, copies the real freshness.mjs into <fixture>/docs/evidence/review/shared/, and spawns that copy; the real repository is never written to

cases.assertion: a tsconfig two levels deep is discovered as a root (2 counted, not 1)
extends cycle reports EXTENDS_CYCLE, exit 1, chain first == last
restoring the acyclic config restores FRESH (detector is not sticky)
diamond a->{b,c}->d is not reported as a cycle
baseline written with no declaration present
one source file before the declaration
a new .d.ts outside src is STALE_BUILD, not ignored

mutation.target: the cycle branch, single point: `if (at >= 0) {` -> `if (at >= 0 && false) {`
mutation.appliedTo: a copy of the file in %TEMP%, selected with `--gate`; the repository file was never edited

red.failureShape: STALE_BUILD instead of EXTENDS_CYCLE, i.e. the cycle degrades into ordinary drift — exactly the old silent behaviour

independentClaimChecks.claim: the baseline diff is two lines only (version 3 -> 4, generatedAt)
independentClaimChecks.observed: exactly those two hunks; every package and tsconfig digest is unchanged

independentClaimChecks.claim: the real tree is unchanged in count

notRepeated.realTreeMutations: r7t1 already added and removed packages/eda-core/src/tsconfig.json and packages/eda-core/types/probe.d.ts against the real tree. Repeating that adds no information and would leave probe files in packages/, so the selftest covers the same path in throwaway workspaces instead. This is a deliberate difference in method, not a skipped check.

remainingLimits: extends package specifiers resolve from the repository-root node_modules only; a package-local node_modules is not consulted
.d.ts under lib/ is treated as build output and is not pinned
per-package tsdown/test configs are outside ROOT_CONFIGS
blockingLeftovers: none: the three declared boundaries now fail closed or are pinned, and the cases are in the repository so the next change can be held to them

t53.summary: PASS: 21 components (8 part + 13 netflag), 55 wires, 2 pages

overall: pass — r7t1's three boundaries are real and closed; its claims reproduce; the cases are now runnable from the repository
